dedupe_keys.name: open industrial energy dataset with asset level measurements and 15 minute aggregates from a manufacturing facility 43 assets about one year

description: Electricity measurements from the machines and distribution assets of one medium-sized manufacturing facility. The abstract of the data paper (Data, 1 May 2026) says energy meters on Ethernet and RS-485 links, integrated through industrial gateways and programmable logic controllers, fed a SCADA logging system and SQL historian over about a year with staged commissioning; the released data are fixed 15-minute energy and power metrics from 43 monitored assets, 1,039,873 windows and 2.96 GWh of measured energy, with interval records of consumption, demand, data coverage and reliability indicators; mean window coverage is 99.99% and 97.72% of windows meet the reliability criterion. The article is open access under CC BY 4.0 and says the dataset is openly accessible, but the repository hosting the files is not stated on the pages read because the publisher's site was blocked. Coverage is one facility; its location and industry are not named in the abstract. Caveats: heterogeneous start dates across assets and a single site. For simulation it gives realistic machine-level load profiles of a factory for demand response, outage impact and on-site energy models. Related catalogue records include the HIPE and SPARK industrial energy datasets from KIT.
